summary: Reject invalid fleet admission before service stop and verify Claude plugin-disable usage before installation.

replay.detail: No claim replay or history rewriting.

schema.detail: Read-only migration binding preflight; no database schema changes.

rules.detail: Existing locked admission still checks membership and store binding before writing.

compatibility.detail: Create rejects existing membership and invalid member names before service inspection; migration rejects membership, invalid names and unbound/mismatched stores before service stop. Claude disable preflight requires a matching Usage line, including when unsupported commands return successful generic help.

downtime.detail: Cheap admission errors leave running services alone. Errors after services stop still leave them stopped for inspection.

manual.detail: Inspect an admission failure before restarting stopped services. Unsupported Claude versions must be updated before installation.

recovery.detail: Interrupted create/migrate after membership save but before pin publication has no checkpoint resume; retain state/keys/membership/pin and use documented operator recovery. Saved join checkpoint resume is unchanged. Corrupt databases can also block pinned fleet controls through restored-writer inspection.
